replacements.reason: The source declares two contiguous rows of eight CameraQuake records but indexes the first row from 0 through 15. Exact GALE01 DOL code at 0x80030EF4 uses four outer iterations with four 0x10-byte records each, visiting all 16 records from offsets 0xB0 through 0x1AF in row-major order. Explicit two-dimensional indexing preserves that order and layout without invoking host C out-of-row array indexing.

The adapted cm/types.h records the source-observed bool callback contract. Removing the incompatible return-type cast makes the assignment and all conditional consumers use that same contract without changing pointer size, storage, or call order.

The synthetic aggregate reconstructs original DOL small-data linker adjacency between cm_803BCB18 and cm_803BCB64. Independent ELF statics have no such adjacency, so access the already named camera descriptor directly instead of reproducing a guest address layout.
Preserve the exact source-owned camera aspect value through its semantic global rather than DOL linker-order pointer arithmetic.
Preserve the exact 640-pixel source viewport width through the named descriptor; the synthetic adjacent object read resolves to zero on ELF and produces a NaN camera translation.
Preserve the exact 480-pixel source viewport height through the named descriptor; this removes only the original linker-layout assumption.
